bot.name: IPODevta
bot.short_description: Only the IPOs that pass your filters. Name, board, price, GMP and subscription at 2:30 PM.
bot.description:
IPODevta sends you only the IPOs that pass your filters.

Every market day at 2:30 PM: one clean message per IPO with name, board, price, GMP and subscription. Nothing passes? One line telling you to stay out.

No filters wanted? Join the channel for every open IPO at 9:30 AM.

Information only - not investment advice. Read the RHP.

commands.feedback: Send a note to the team

disclaimer: Grey-market premium is unofficial and can move quickly. Data from IPO Guru and BSE. Information only - not investment advice. Read the RHP.
